name: Office Application Initiated Network Connection Over Uncommon Ports
description: Detects an office suit application (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) communicating to target systems over uncommon ports.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Other ports can be used, apply additional filters accordingly
query: (network.direction:true AND (process.executable:(*\\excel.exe OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\winword.exe OR *\\wordview.exe))) AND (NOT ((destination.port:(53 OR 80 OR 139 OR 443 OR 445)) OR (process.executable:*\:\\Program\ Files\\Microsoft\ Office\\* AND process.executable:*\\OUTLOOK.EXE AND (destination.port:(143 OR 465 OR 587 OR 993 OR 995)))))
